subject: Change of format: engineering office hours + POC sprint
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@orionai.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Change of format: engineering office hours + POC sprint

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for your time on Friday. Based on the signals from your team (engineering-heavy questions + interest in an early integration), we'd like to propose changing the upcoming intro demo into a more hands-on two-part engagement:

- Day 1: Engineering office hours (half day) — live Q&A, model/eval walkthroughs, and short 1:1 breakouts with your engineers.
- Day 2: POC sprint (full day) — pair-programming on a minimal integration, sample prompts, and evaluation checkpoints.

Benefits: faster time to a validated POC, direct pairing with Redwood engineers, and clearer success criteria for the proof-of-concept. I've attached a one-page POC-sprint outline and an .ics with a couple of proposed date ranges.

Proposed windows: Oct 18–19 or Oct 24–25. If either works, we can lock resources and circulate a draft agenda. Can you share who from your team would attend (product vs. engineers) and whether you prefer remote, hybrid, or onsite?

Attachments: POC-sprint-outline.pdf, redwood-availability.ics

Next steps: reply with availability and attendee list; we'll confirm the engineering leads and send calendar invites.

Thanks — looking forward to making this practical for your team.

– Priyom
Priyom Das | Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@orionai.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Team <dev-team@orionai.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 11:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Change of format: engineering office hours + POC sprint

Priyom — thanks for the suggestion, we like the approach. A quick heads up: leadership and half our engineering team will be traveling during the Oct 18–19 window (exec offsite). Can we look at Oct 24–25 instead?

A few asks from our side:
- Prefer a split: a short product-oriented overview for our PMs before the office hours (30–45m) and a separate engineering track for the rest.
- For the POC sprint, half-days are preferable for some engineers who are on-call; can we structure day 2 as two focused half-day sessions (AM: infra + integration, PM: model behavior & eval)?
- Please share prework (sample data format + minimal integration steps) so our infra lead can prep.

Attendees likely: 1 PM (Meera), 3 engineers (Luis, Hana, Ravi), plus our SRE lead (Tomas). I can firm up names once we confirm dates.

-- Alex
Alex Chen | Director of Platform | Orion AI
alex.chen@orionai.com | +1 (650) 555-0199
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 08:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Change of format: engineering office hours + POC sprint (customer prefers Oct 24–25)

Markus / Monica — forwarding Alex's reply. Customer prefers Oct 24–25 and wants a split product + engineering track, plus a two-part POC day (two half-days). Can you confirm Redwood staffing for the following?

- Day 1: Product overview (30–45m) + 3 concurrent 1:1 engineering office-hours slots (2x engineers per slot) — need 3 Redwood engineers.
- Day 2: POC sprint structured as AM (integration + infra) and PM (model tuning & eval) — need 2 engs each block, one floater to triage infra issues.

Monica, can you take ownership of calendar invites and prework distribution? I've attached the outline and the .ics; once Markus confirms leads, I'll send a single combined invite with separate session blocks (so customer can accept portions).

Also flagging that Alex asked for a short product overview before the engineering session — we should keep that tight and aim for 40 minutes, led by product.

Thanks —
Priyom
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 06 Oct 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Change of format: engineering office hours + POC sprint (staffing + agenda)

Thanks for the sync, Priyom. We can staff this. Proposed staffing:
- Product overview: Laura Bennett (product) — will keep to 40 minutes + Q&A.
- Engineering office hours: Marcus Lin, Rishi Malhotra, and one engineer from Dedicated runtime (I'll confirm a name).
- POC sprint: Marcus and Rishi will cover model/integration blocks; I'll assign a floater for infra (likely Diego).

Draft run of show (high level):
- Day 1 (Oct 24 AM): Product overview (40m)
- Day 1 (Oct 24 PM): Three 45m office-hour breakouts (eng breakouts)
- Day 2 (Oct 25 AM): Integration + infra pairing (AM half-day)
- Day 2 (Oct 25 PM): Model behavior, quant/latency tradeoffs, evaluation checkpoints (PM half-day)

Notes:
- We'll prepare a short set of prework items (sample payload shape + simple Dockerized example) and link those in the invite. Monica — can you attach the prework doc and the POC-sprint-outline.pdf when you send invites?
- Pricing/credits: if the customer wants an extended multi-day on-site, we might need to discuss a modest professional services credit; leave that to deal team to flag if it comes up.

I'll confirm specific engineer names by EOD Friday.

-Markus
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@orionai.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Change of format: engineering office hours + POC sprint (staffing + agenda)

Priyom / Markus / Monica — thanks, that plan works for us. Oct 24–25 confirmed from our side. We'll plan to send calendar holds for 3 engineers + 1 product manager.

Requests before day 1:
- Send the prework link and the POC-sprint-outline.pdf to the attendees (we'll push the infra folks to review the sample payload).
- For the office hours breakouts, we prefer session topics to be: integration patterns, rate-limiting & scaling, and evaluation metrics.

Once we have the updated invites, I'll circulate to our team. Appreciate the flexibility here — looks like a good path to accelerate the POC.

Best,
Alex
